PudoAutocompleteBase.text: query PudoAutocompleteBase( $latitude: Float $longitude: Float $numberOfResults: Int $query: String! ) { pudoAutocomplete( latitude: $latitude longitude: $longitude numberOfResults: $numberOfResults query: $query ) { ...PudoFragmentBase } }

PudoLocationSearch.text: query PudoLocationSearch( $isUserTriggeredFallback: Boolean $latitude: Float! $longitude: Float! $query: String! $type: EnumRVWebCommonPickupOrDropoff! ) { pudoLocationSearch( isUserTriggeredFallback: $isUserTriggeredFallback latitude: $latitude longitude: $longitude query: $query type: $type ) { ...PudoLocationSearchFragment } }

PudoFlights.text: query PudoFlights( $arrivalAirport: String $arrivalISODate: String $departureAirport: String $departureTimeMsec: Float! # timestamp, graphQL Int does not handle timestamp $pageNumber: Int $pageSize: Int $type: EnumRVWebCommonFlightSearchType $query: String! ) { pudoFlights( arrivalAirport: $arrivalAirport arrivalISODate: $arrivalISODate departureAirport: $departureAirport departureTimeMsec: $departureTimeMsec pageNumber: $pageNumber pageSize: $pageSize type: $type query: $query ) { ...PudoFlightFragment } }

PudoResolveLocationPudoFragment.text: query PudoResolveLocationPudoFragment( $id: String $includeAirportTerminals: Boolean = false $includeRAPUStatus: Boolean = false $includeTimezone: Boolean = false $source: EnumRVWebCommonLocationSource $provider: String $latitude: Float $longitude: Float ) { pudoResolveLocation( id: $id source: $source provider: $provider latitude: $latitude longitude: $longitude ) { ...PudoFragment timezone @include(if: $includeTimezone) airportTerminals @include(if: $includeAirportTerminals) { ...AirportTerminalsFragment } reserveAirportPickupData @include(if: $includeRAPUStatus) { ...ReserveAirportPickupData } } }

PudoResolveLocation.text: query PudoResolveLocation( $id: String $includeTimezone: Boolean = false $source: EnumRVWebCommonLocationSource $provider: String $latitude: Float $longitude: Float ) { pudoResolveLocation( id: $id source: $source provider: $provider latitude: $latitude longitude: $longitude ) { ...PudoFragment timezone @include(if: $includeTimezone) addressComponents { ...PudoAddressComponentsFragment } } }

PudoSuggestions.text: query PudoSuggestions( $includeAccelerators: Boolean = false # deprecated $includeDestinations: Boolean! $includeOrigins: Boolean! $includeAirportTerminals: Boolean = false $includeRAPUStatus: Boolean = false $includeTimezone: Boolean = false $latitude: Float! $longitude: Float! ) { pudoSuggestions( includeAccelerators: $includeAccelerators includeDestinations: $includeDestinations includeOrigins: $includeOrigins latitude: $latitude longitude: $longitude ) { ...PudoFragment timezone @include(if: $includeTimezone) airportTerminals @include(if: $includeAirportTerminals) { ...AirportTerminalsFragment } reserveAirportPickupData @include(if: $includeRAPUStatus) { ...ReserveAirportPickupData } } }

PudoResolveInitialParams.text: query PudoResolveInitialParams( # setup $includePickup: Boolean! $includeDrop0: Boolean! $includeDrop1: Boolean! $includeDrop2: Boolean! $includeDrop3: Boolean! $includeDrop4: Boolean! $includeFlight: Boolean! # pickup $pickupID: String $pickupProvider: String $pickupLatitude: Float $pickupLongitude: Float $pickupSource: EnumRVWebCommonLocationSource # drop0 $drop0ID: String $drop0Provider: String $drop0Latitude: Float $drop0Longitude: Float $drop0Source: EnumRVWebCommonLocationSource # drop1 $drop1ID: String $drop1Provider: String $drop1Latitude: Float $drop1Longitude: Float $drop1Source: EnumRVWebCommonLocationSource # drop2 $drop2ID: String $drop2Provider: String $drop2Latitude: Float $drop2Longitude: Float $drop2Source: EnumRVWebCommonLocationSource # drop3 $drop3ID: String $drop3Provider: String $drop3Latitude: Float $drop3Longitude: Float $drop3Source: EnumRVWebCommonLocationSource # drop4 $drop4ID: String $drop4Provider: String $drop4Latitude: Float $drop4Longitude: Float $drop4Source: EnumRVWebCommonLocationSource # flight $flightID: String! ) { pickup: pudoResolveLocation( id: $pickupID provider: $pickupProvider source: $pickupSource latitude: $pickupLatitude longitude: $pickupLongitude ) @include(if: $includePickup) { ...PudoFragment ...TimezoneAndAirportDataFragment } drop0: pudoResolveLocation( id: $drop0ID provider: $drop0Provider source: $drop0Source latitude: $drop0Latitude longitude: $drop0Longitude ) @include(if: $includeDrop0) { ...PudoFragment ...TimezoneAndAirportDataFragment } drop1: pudoResolveLocation( id: $drop1ID provider: $drop1Provider source: $drop1Source latitude: $drop1Latitude longitude: $drop1Longitude ) @include(if: $includeDrop1) { ...PudoFragment ...TimezoneAndAirportDataFragment } drop2: pudoResolveLocation( id: $drop2ID provider: $drop2Provider source: $drop2Source latitude: $drop2Latitude longitude: $drop2Longitude ) @include(if: $includeDrop2) { ...PudoFragment ...TimezoneAndAirportDataFragment } drop3: pudoResolveLocation( id: $drop3ID provider: $drop3Provider source: $drop3Source latitude: $drop3Latitude longitude: $drop3Longitude ) @include(if: $includeDrop3) { ...PudoFragment ...TimezoneAndAirportDataFragment } drop4: pudoResolveLocation( id: $drop4ID provider: $drop4Provider source: $drop4Source latitude: $drop4Latitude longitude: $drop4Longitude ) @include(if: $includeDrop4) { ...PudoFragment ...TimezoneAndAirportDataFragment } flight: pudoResolveFlight(id: $flightID) @include(if: $includeFlight) { ...PudoFlightFragment } }

PudoLocationRefinement.text: query PudoLocationRefinement( $pickup: InputRVWebCommonCoordinate! $pickupTime: Float $vvid: Int! $id: String $provider: String $source: EnumRVWebCommonLocationSource ) { pudoLocationRefinement( pickup: $pickup pickupTime: $pickupTime vvid: $vvid id: $id provider: $provider source: $source ) { anchor { ...PudoFragment locationRefinementMeta { instructions segment } timezone } containingZonePolygonPoints { latitude longitude } locations { ...RefinedLocationFragment } mode } }

PudoCitySearch.text: query PudoCitySearch { pudoCitySearch { cityGroups { name cityIds } cities { id name countryCode countryName coordinate { latitude longitude } } } }

WayfindingInstructions.text: query WayfindingInstructions( $accessPointId: String! $dataVersion: String $requestSource: String ) { wayfindingInstructions( accessPointId: $accessPointId dataVersion: $dataVersion requestSource: $requestSource ) { level photoUrl shortDescription subtitle title tstSubtitle steps { icon level location { latitude longitude } mapLabelText photoUrl stepType subtitle title } } }
